title.narrative: Guinea Natural Resources, Mining and Environmental Management Project

description.narrative: The Development Objective is to strengthen institutional capacities for integrated management of mineral and natural resources in Guinea and enhanced benefits from the mining and environment sectors.

The development objective of Natural Resources, Mining and Environmental Management Project is to strengthen institutional capacities for integrated management of mineral and natural resources in Guinea and enhanced benefits from the mining and environment sectors. There are four components in this project. 1) The first component, Improve the institutional framework for mining and environment, has the following sub-components: (i) Coordination of mining and environment strategy and regulation; (ii) Tools to enhance mining and environment coordination; and (iii) Strengthening Guinea's capacity to address its global commitment on climate change. 2) The second component, Mining policies, institutions, governance and economic integration, has the following sub-components: (i) Mining policies, institutions and access to resources, which has the following sub-components: (a) Mining related policies, laws, regulations and guides; (b) Access to resources; and (c) Capacity building of mining public institutions; (ii) Economic integration of the mining sector and governance, has the following sub-components: (a) Local content and economic integration enablers; and (ii) Transparency and citizen engagement. 3) The third component, Environmental and natural resources management, has the following sub-components: (i) Institutional, logistical support and Environmental and Social Standards (ESS) management; and (ii) Protected area management in selected areas. 4) The fourth component, Project management, will finance the operational costs of the Project Implementation Unit (PIU).
